1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Confirm that a brake performance test was conducted.
3. Verify failure of the inspection record.
4. Document the specific areas of the test failure (front, rear, drum or disc).
5. Document that the vehicle will be of limited pass unless further action is taken.

By following these accurate instructions, you can effectively document and track failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report. This allows for proper inspection records to be kept on file for future reference.

Introduction: In the automotive industry, vehicle inspections are performed to ensure that vehicles are roadworthy and meet safety standards. A significant aspect of this inspection process involves testing the vehicle’s braking system.

When a brake test fails during the inspection process, it is crucial to accurately document this information in the vehicle inspection report. This allows for proper inspection records to be kept on file for future reference.
